_comment: Pre-registered pipeline parameters (technical pre-registration, sibling of analysis/ablation-candidates.md). Freeze before any full run; every change after the first full run must be documented in the paper.
_calibration_log: 2026-07-22 (a): k_grid extended past 80 after the pilot run showed a boundary optimum (silhouette monotonically rising at k=80 for both bge-m3 and nomic-embed-text; largest cluster still held 24% of segments). 2026-07-22 (b): extended to 400/500 because bge-m3 still peaked at the k=300 boundary while nomic peaked interior at 250; checking empirically whether bge has an interior optimum or silhouette monotonically rewards near-duplicate granularity on this corpus. Recorded for the paper's methods section. 2026-07-22 (c): taxonomy stability metric changed from best-match Jaccard to best-match containment |A∩B|/|A| after the pilot showed Jaccard conflates instability with granularity mismatch between models (large well-co-grouped clusters split 2-3-ways by the other model scored ~0.3); threshold kept at 0.5.
